scenes.heading: Index Definitions in Cloud Service
scenes.narration: Oak & Operations. Index Definitions in Cloud Service. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: How does the Cloud Service model change index configuration compared with single-instance thinking?
scenes.heading: In Cloud Service, index configuration is specified before deployment and not changed on a running instance
scenes.body: Section 4 says index configuration in Cloud Service is specified before a deployment, not changed on a running instance.

scenes.question: What does the speech say about user access to the Index Manager in Cloud Service?
scenes.heading: Users do not have access to the Index Manager of a single instance in the cloud

scenes.question: What happens to indexes during a rolling deployment, and where can you see job completion?
scenes.heading: Two sets of indexes exist, one for the old version and one for the new version, and the Cloud Manager build page shows whether indexing is complete
scenes.body: Section 4 says that rolling deployments use two index sets and that the Cloud Manager build page shows whether the indexing job is complete.

scenes.question: Which index type is supported for customer customization in Cloud Service?

scenes.question: Which async values are allowed for customized Cloud Service indexes?
scenes.heading: The async property can be async, async and nrt, or fulltext-async

scenes.question: Which project setup steps does the speech require for Cloud Service index definitions?
scenes.heading: Use filevault-package-maven-plugin 1.3.2 or later, add oak:index to immutableRootNodeNames, enable allowIndexDefinitions and noIntermediateSaves in ui.apps and ui.apps.structure, and add a filter for /oak:index in ui.apps.structure

scenes.heading: Quick recap
items: In Cloud Service, index configuration is specified before deployment and not changed on a running instance
Users do not have access to the Index Manager of a single instance in the cloud
Two sets of indexes exist, one for the old version and one for the new version, and the Cloud Manager build page shows whether indexing is complete
Only indexes of type lucene are supported for customization
The async property can be async, async and nrt, or fulltext-async
Only standard product analyzers are supported, so custom analyzers are not, and useInSimilarity is not supported

Use filevault-package-maven-plugin 1.3.2 or later, add oak:index to immutableRootNodeNames, enable allowIndexDefinitions and noIntermediateSaves in ui.apps and ui.apps.structure, and add a filter for /oak:index in ui.apps.structure
